crossRefs.note: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.
and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven…
Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.
Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

translations.web: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.
translations.bsb: The women who had come with Jesus from Galilee followed, and they saw the tomb and how His body was placed.
translations.kjv: And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the sepulchre, and how his body was laid.
translations.asv: And the women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and beheld the tomb, and how his body was laid.
